_meta.description: SR-specific champion builds for coach_integration.py SR coaching.
_meta.notes: Different from ARAM builds - SR starts 450g, no ARAM buffs, matchup-dependent first items

Vayne.vs_tanks: Terminus already in core (on-hit % pen ramp); Fiendhunter Bolts 4th (60.52% WR per the external aggregator)
Vayne.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder swap for Hexplate vs sustain
Vayne.vs_burst: Jak'Sho, The Protean 4th (55.17% WR per the external aggregator); Guardian Angel 6th (63.18% WR)
Vayne.build_note: BotRK + Rageblade + Terminus = full anti-tank on-hit stack. Doran's Bow new starter (26.9) is theoretically aggressive alt but Doran's Blade still default per the external aggregator.
Vayne.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve) or 1100g (Recurve + Long Sword). Never sit at 500g - wasteful.
Vayne.kit_notes: % true-damage on-hit ADC; W every 3rd AA = % max HP true. Q dash + invis from R. Invis-dash kite pattern is core.

Jinx.vs_tanks: LDR 5th - Collector(25%) + RFC(25%) + IE(25%) = 75% crit active before LDR
Jinx.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR if 2+ sustain - never both
Jinx.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector if 3+ divers
Jinx.build_note: Yun Tal gives AS not crit in S16. Need RFC for 25% crit, then Collector for 50% before IE. IE fully activates at 75% total. Never switch to rockets until Yun Tal complete - minigun stacks plates faster.
Jinx.recall_timing: Back at 1050g (Yun Tal component BF Sword) or 900g (Recurve + pickaxe path).

Tristana.vs_tanks: LDR 4th - physical burst scales with armor pen
Tristana.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Tristana.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Stormrazor vs heavy burst
Tristana.build_note: Collector first for early execute + plates value. Stormrazor slows make E all-ins guaranteed. Never use W offensively when behind - it's your escape. E stacks: 3 on tower before 14min = plates gold.
Tristana.recall_timing: Back at 1300g (BF Sword) or 875g (Pickaxe). Never sit on 500g.

Caitlyn.first_back: Noonquiver (1300g) or Pickaxe + Cloak (toward Hexoptics C44)
Caitlyn.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 4th (60.57% WR per the external aggregator)
Caitlyn.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder 4th (54.02% WR per the external aggregator)
Caitlyn.vs_burst: Bloodthirster 4th (58.04% WR per the external aggregator) or Guardian Angel 6th (62.89% WR)
Caitlyn.build_note: Kraken Slayer core 1st item - on-hit chain procs RFC stacks faster. RFC extends headshot to 850+ for safe poke. IE activates at 75% crit.
Caitlyn.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Hexoptics C44 half-item). E is escape only - never burn offensively.
Caitlyn.kit_notes: Lane-bully ADC; passive headshot every 6 AAs (extended range, bonus damage). W trap setup. R global execute. Net (E) is escape - never burn forward.

Nilah.first_back: Recurve Bow (800g) or Long Sword if < 800g
Nilah.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + BotRK core - never skip either
Nilah.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder 4th - melee range means you sustain fight long enough for it to matter
Nilah.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 3rd provides shield during melee all-in
Nilah.build_note: All-in ONLY on confirmed ally CC. E flip = engage AND escape - never use without a CC chain. W active reduces enemy healing. Melee ADC in lane - play passive until jungler comes or level 6.
Nilah.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). Never extend when support is dead.

Miss Fortune.first_back: BF Sword (1300g) or Caulfield's Warhammer (1100g) vs armor
Miss Fortune.vs_tanks: LDR mandatory - Collector(25%) + Phantom Dancer(20%) + IE(25%) = 70% crit active
Miss Fortune.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR - never both
Miss Fortune.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer vs heavy burst
Miss Fortune.build_note: Strut (W) stacks when out of combat - don't get poked. E rain slows then Bullet Time = guaranteed full channel. Ult angle: perpendicular to enemy team, 30-45 degrees for max spread.
Miss Fortune.recall_timing: Back at 1300g (BF Sword for Collector) or 1100g (Caulfield's vs all-in threat).

Lucian.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards already in 6-item; pull to 4th vs heavy armor
Lucian.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder 4th (56.04% WR per the external aggregator) - replaces LDR slot
Lucian.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer vs 3+ divers - always keep TF
Lucian.build_note: Trinity Force is MANDATORY first item. Q activates Spellblade AND Lightslinger: bonus damage + empowered auto + second auto = 3-hit burst. Rush TF via Long Sword → Caulfield's → Sheen. Never RFC.
Lucian.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Caulfield's Warhammer) or 800g (Pickaxe + Dagger). TF complete by 12-13min target.
Lucian.kit_notes: Double-shot passive (after ability cast); Q line poke, E dash reset on takedown, R Culling channel-spray (commit to fight). Pairs with engage support (Nami/Braum/Leona).

Ezreal.first_back: Tear of the Goddess (400g) - buy at first recall regardless of gold
Ezreal.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's double armor pen - Q applies both
Ezreal.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Ezreal.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs assassins
Ezreal.build_note: Buy Tear FIRST back no matter what - stack immediately via Q spam. TF Spellblade + Muramana on Q = core damage. Serylda's slows enemies on Q hit. E is your ONLY escape - never burn forward.
Ezreal.recall_timing: Buy Tear at first recall (400g). Full Manamune stacked = power spike. TF complete ~14min.

Jhin.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 4th (57.33% WR per the external aggregator)
Jhin.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder 4th (53.37% WR per the external aggregator)
Jhin.vs_burst: Guardian Angel 6th (62.13% WR slot per the external aggregator); Bloodthirster swap
Jhin.build_note: Hubris (still 55 AD post-26.9 nerf, snowball stack) + Collector executes + IE crit damage = the lethality-crit hybrid jhin meta. Boots of Swiftness MANDATORY (88.39% PR) for kiting.
Jhin.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (BF Sword path) or 875g (Pickaxe). Reload window forces repositioning - track enemy aggression.
Jhin.kit_notes: 4-shot lethality ADC; passive crit converts to AD scaling (more crit = more raw AD). 4th shot is guaranteed crit + execute on low HP. Boots of Swiftness for kiting + W root setups.

Ashe.first_back: Noonquiver (1300g) or Pickaxe + Cloak (toward Hexoptics C44)
Ashe.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards already in core (61.54% WR slot per the external aggregator)
Ashe.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder swap for LDR (57.77% WR per the external aggregator)
Ashe.vs_burst: Guardian Angel 6th (65.85% WR slot per the external aggregator)
Ashe.build_note: Kraken Slayer core 1st item (alt to Statikk Shiv reworked 26.9). PD + IE = 75% crit active by 3rd item. A second external aggregator shows 55.7% WR confirming meta. The external aggregator alt core Kraken/PD/IE (57.48% WR) viable but lower PR.
Ashe.recall_timing: Back at 875g (Pickaxe) or 800g (Recurve Bow). Stack Ranger's Focus on minions before trades.
Ashe.kit_notes: Crit-utility ADC; passive crit converts to bonus slow damage (no AAs miss-crit damage). W AOE poke. R global stun engage.

Draven.vs_tanks: LDR 5th - Collector(25%) + Phantom Dancer(20%) + Navori(25%) + IE(25%) = 95% crit
Draven.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Draven.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer vs heavy burst
Draven.build_note: Catch BOTH Spinning Axes on every throw - lose axes = lose stacks. League of Draven passive stacks on every kill. Convert stacks with R on low-HP escaping enemies. Caulfield's rush for early haste.
Draven.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Caulfield's) or 1300g (BF Sword). Never extend when axes are dropped.

Xayah.vs_tanks: LDR 5th - Yun Tal(0%) + RFC(25%) + Collector(25%) + IE(25%) = 75% crit
Xayah.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Xayah.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs assassins
Xayah.build_note: Yun Tal gives AS not crit in S16 - need RFC as crit bridge. Plant feathers with autos, E pulls all through the group. R (Featherstorm) is invincible - use to dodge Malphite R, Lux R, any burst.
Xayah.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow) to start Yun Tal path. Never use R proactively - save for incoming burst.

Samira.vs_tanks: LDR 5th - Collector(25%) + Navori(25%) + ISB(25%) + IE(25%) = 100% crit
Samira.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Samira.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow already in core build
Samira.build_note: Style rank D→S via alternating melee Q / ranged auto + using ally CC nearby. R (Inferno Trigger) only at S rank - build rank on 3+ enemies before R. Weave through grouped enemies with passive dashes.
Samira.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Caulfield's). Don't extend when style rank is below C - vulnerable before R available.

Sivir.vs_tanks: LDR 4th - Boomerang Blade (Q) procs LDR through groups
Sivir.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Sivir.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs assassins
Sivir.build_note: Navori reduces Q/W cooldown on crit - Ricochet (W) bounces become constant. Spell Shield (E) blocks one ability - save for hard CC or Caitlyn R. On-hit from Ricochet stacks Q haste faster.
Sivir.recall_timing: Back at 875g (Pickaxe). Q/W to clear waves fast - crash and recall every 3 waves.

Varus.first_back: Recurve Bow (800g) or Pickaxe if ahead
Varus.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR - W blight + Kraken true damage shreds through max armor
Varus.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Varus.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs assassins
Varus.build_note: W (Blighted Quiver): stack 3 blight with autos, then E root detonates for % max HP burst. R chain of corruption jumps between enemies - throw into grouped cluster at objectives.
Varus.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). Never Q charge in place - stationary = gank target.

Kalista.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR - Rend detonates Kraken procs through tanks simultaneously
Kalista.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Kalista.build_note: NEVER stand still - every auto hops to new position. Stack 4+ spears on target before Rend (E). Hurricane plants spears on 3 targets simultaneously. R throws support into enemy team - coordinate the timing.
Kalista.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). Kalista needs AS more than AD early - Recurve first is correct.

Zeri.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR + Rageblade double on-hit synergy
Zeri.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain - never both
Zeri.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Guinsoo's vs heavy assassin
Zeri.build_note: Q (Burst Fire) passes through minions - chip enemies through waves for free. E (Spark Surge) wall-hop for flank angles or escape. R overcharge: every kill extends - all-in at 2+ enemies grouped.
Zeri.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). E wall-hops available - use to find safe recall paths.

Naafiri.first_back: Long Sword + Pickaxe (toward Voltaic Cyclosword Caulfield's path)
Naafiri.vs_tanks: Serylda's Grudge already in core; add Black Cleaver 4th if 2+ tanks (replaces Edge of Night)
Naafiri.vs_healing: Serpent's Fang 4th (the external aggregator 56.52% WR in slot)
Naafiri.vs_burst: Edge of Night earlier (move to 2nd) for spell shield
Naafiri.kit_notes: Pack-of-dogs assassin; W spawns dogs that boost AD/AS. Q1 dash + Q2 follow is her gap-close + execute. R doubles dog count and grants tracking - engage tool, not escape.
Naafiri.build_note: Voltaic Cyclosword now ability-trigger (26.9 rework) - synergizes with Q-spam burst pattern. EoN second buys spell shield for bursting back into fights.

variants.name: axiom_high_wr
variants.note: 59.19% WR alt 3-core per the external aggregator

Lux.vs_tanks: Void Staff 4th (move ahead of Rabadon's) for % MR pen
Lux.vs_healing: Cryptbloom replaces Void Staff (% MR pen + healing aura unique to her support flex pool)
Lux.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass replaces Stormsurge as 3rd (53.66% WR per the external aggregator)
Lux.kit_notes: Long-range mage; Q binds 2 targets, E AOE slow + detonation, R global beam. Passive marks targets that her own AAs/spells detonate for AOE bonus damage.
Lux.build_note: Luden's first for waveclear + roam burst. Stormsurge/Shadowflame stack burst for one-shot R fishing. Build pivots to Cryptbloom in support role (not covered here - mid only).

Sylas.first_back: Lost Chapter or Hextech Alternator (toward Rocketbelt)
Sylas.vs_tanks: Void Staff 5th (per the external aggregator recommendation)
Sylas.vs_burst: Zhonya's earlier (move to 2nd); also consider Banshee's Veil swap
Sylas.kit_notes: Mage-bruiser hybrid; R steals enemy ult. E-Q is gap-close + bonus damage chain. Riftmaker omnivamp + Zhonya's stasis pair to brawl through teamfights.
Sylas.build_note: Rocketbelt engage tool; Riftmaker omnivamp keeps him alive in melee range. Swap Riftmaker -> Shadowflame vs heavy shield comp.

Ahri.vs_tanks: Void Staff 4th (ahead of Rabadon's) for % MR pen
Ahri.vs_healing: Morellonomicon replaces Shadowflame slot vs Soraka/Aatrox
Ahri.vs_burst: Zhonya's 2nd (before Shadowflame) or Banshee's Veil swap for late game
Ahri.kit_notes: Mobile burst-mage; R triple-dash for engage + reposition + escape. E charm sets up Q max-damage and R reposition burst rotation.
Ahri.build_note: Malignance R cd reduction + magic pen synergy is core. Shadowflame for execute on low-HP escapes. Ionian Boots viable alt (52.86% WR) when ult-cd matters more than mpen.

Akali.first_back: Hextech Alternator + Long Sword (toward Hextech Gunblade)
Akali.vs_healing: Morellonomicon replaces Shadowflame (or 6th item if Shadowflame kept)
Akali.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil 6th (per the external aggregator); Mercury's Treads boots swap (16.09% PR)
Akali.kit_notes: Energy-based assassin; R double-dash execute; passive empowered AA after ability. E-Q-AA kill rotation post-6.
Akali.build_note: Hextech Gunblade gives omnivamp + active dash - core to her brawling pattern. Sorcerer's pen prio over Mercs unless heavy AP burst lane.

Yone.first_back: Noonquiver (1300g) or BotRK component (Recurve + Vamp Scepter)
Yone.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 4th (replaces Death's Dance in slot, 57.5% WR per the external aggregator)
Yone.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder 4th (57.61% WR per the external aggregator)
Yone.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow already 2nd in core - keep position
Yone.kit_notes: Crit-AA bruiser-assassin; Q3 knockup + AA dash, E swap dash, R AOE knockup engage. Doran's Bow new aggressive starter (26.9) replaces Doran's Blade for AA-trade pattern.
Yone.build_note: BotRK first for % HP on-hit + active slow. Shieldbow shield mid-fight survival. New Doran's Bow starter (44.76% PR) is post-26.9 shift over Doran's Shield (31.64% PR).

Zed.vs_tanks: Serylda's Grudge already core; Black Cleaver swap if 3+ tanks
Zed.vs_healing: Serpent's Fang replaces Edge of Night
Zed.vs_burst: Edge of Night earlier (move to 4th); Maw of Malmortius vs heavy AP
Zed.kit_notes: Energy assassin; R shadow swap + delayed mark execute. W shadow + E AOE slow defines burst combo. Voltaic Cyclosword (26.9 ability-trigger) procs off Q.
Zed.build_note: Voltaic Cyclosword + Axiom Arc lethality + ult-cd refund stack - defines snowball pattern. Hubris removed from default since 26.9 nerf (60AD->55AD); the external aggregator shows VC + Axiom + Serylda's at 57.36% core WR.

Veigar.first_back: Tear of the Goddess (400g) - buy first back regardless of gold
Veigar.vs_healing: Cryptbloom 5th (63.22% WR per the external aggregator) replaces Zhonya's
Veigar.vs_burst: Zhonya's 4th (move ahead of Deathcap, 59.01% WR slot)
Veigar.kit_notes: Stack-passive caster; Q stacks AP per minion/champ kill. E cage stun is the setup tool. R execute scales with target's missing HP.
Veigar.build_note: Tear MUST buy first back regardless of gold - stack via Q spam ASAP. RoA evolves at 10min into Seraph's. Late-game Deathcap snowballs his stack pattern.

Katarina.first_back: Noonquiver or Recurve Bow (toward Kraken Slayer)
Katarina.vs_tanks: Terminus already in core; Void Staff 5th
Katarina.vs_healing: Morellonomicon swap for Rabadon's vs sustain comp
Katarina.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass 4th (58.82% WR slot, 64.79% as 5th per the external aggregator)
Katarina.kit_notes: Reset-mechanic assassin; passive throws daggers on cd, pickup grants empowered AA + AOE. R channeled AOE is the fight-winner - needs cover.
Katarina.build_note: Crit-bruiser hybrid build (Kraken/BotRK/Terminus) is the meta - different from old AP burst pattern. Mercs treads viable (20.46% PR) into heavy CC.

Talon.vs_tanks: Serylda's Grudge already in core; Black Cleaver if 2+ tanks
Talon.vs_healing: Serpent's Fang 4th (53.6% WR per the external aggregator)
Talon.vs_burst: Edge of Night 4th (58.53% WR per the external aggregator)
Talon.kit_notes: Lethality assassin; W AOE blade rake + bleed, E wall-jump, R invis dash + AOE on reveal. Roam-heavy - Youmuu's MS is core.
Talon.build_note: Pure lethality stack. Voltaic Cyclosword (26.9 ability-trigger) hits W & R AOE. Youmuu's MS scales his roam advantage post-6.

Singed.first_back: Catalyst of Aeons (1100g) toward Rod of Ages -> Liandry's path
Singed.vs_tanks: Riftmaker 4th (67.09% WR per the external aggregator) - replaces Protoplasm
Singed.vs_healing: Morellonomicon flex 5th (Singed kit doesn't natively need it but vs Soraka/Aatrox swap in)
Singed.kit_notes: Proxy-farm tank-mage; Q poison trail damage scales with target HP. W ground glue. E flip turns chasers into kited corpses. R ult buff stats + MS.
Singed.build_note: Boots of Swiftness (NOT Sorcerer's) is mandatory - kiting is his win condition. Liandry's HP-burn pairs with Rylai's slow + Q-trail uptime.

Garen.vs_tanks: Mortal Reminder already in core (anti-heal AND armor pen). Add Lord Dominik's later if 3+ tanks
Garen.vs_burst: Dead Man's Plate / Sterak's Gage earlier (move to 4th); Force of Nature vs heavy AP
Garen.kit_notes: Crit-bruiser since rework; Q empowered AA + silence + MS. E spin AOE crit. R execute scales with missing HP. AAs mark for R bonus damage.
Garen.build_note: Crit-bruiser meta (Stridebreaker + PD + MR) over old tank build. IE 5th alt (59.1% WR) for full damage.

Darius.vs_tanks: Sterak's Gage 4th (60.94% WR per the external aggregator) for HP scaling
Darius.vs_healing: Death's Dance gives sustain - for direct anti-heal swap Chempunk Chainsword 4th
Darius.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage / Maw of Malmortius earlier
Darius.kit_notes: 5-stack-bleed bruiser; passive bleed stacks +AD per stack. E pull. R true-damage execute resets on kill (snowball tool).
Darius.build_note: Lethality-into-bruiser hybrid. Youmuu's MS + Dead Man's Plate MS = closes gap on kited targets. R-reset chains define teamfight pattern.

Sett.vs_tanks: Black Cleaver swap for Spear of Shojin (armor shred stacking)
Sett.vs_healing: Overlord's Bloodmail in core (built-in anti-heal aura)
Sett.kit_notes: HP-stack bruiser; W stores damage taken into a true-damage chunk shield+nuke. E pull-and-stun. R suplex displaces.
Sett.build_note: Overlord's Bloodmail is core for built-in Grievous Wounds aura + HP. Stridebreaker MS-strike for engage. Mercury's Treads viable (25.3% PR, 51.69% WR) into CC.

Jax.first_back: Sheen + Phage (toward Trinity Force) or Long Sword if poor
Jax.vs_tanks: Death's Dance replaces Zhonya's in core
Jax.vs_healing: Wit's End 4th/5th (the external aggregator flagged as anti-heal swap)
Jax.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage 4th (60.37% WR per the external aggregator); Maw vs heavy AP
Jax.kit_notes: AS-scaling bruiser; passive every-3rd-AA bonus magic damage. E counter-stun on incoming AAs. R passive stacks armor+MR per AA - itemize INTO his AS spike.
Jax.build_note: Trinity Force + Sundered Sky for Sheen-scaled burst rotation. Zhonya's stops dive + lets E counter heavy nuke combos. AP-Jax variant exists but crit-trinity is the external aggregator's meta build.

K'Sante.first_back: Sheen or Bami's Cinder (toward Iceborn Gauntlet)
K'Sante.vs_tanks: Anathema's Chains pivot vs single-tank threat
K'Sante.vs_healing: Kaenic Rookern early (53.24% WR per the external aggregator) - also gives MR shield
K'Sante.vs_burst: Thornmail combo (51.4-52.57% WR) or earlier Randuin's
K'Sante.kit_notes: Tank-divetank-bruiser hybrid; R All Out converts armor/MR into AD + AOE knockback. Itemize tank stats - R converts them when needed.
K'Sante.build_note: Doran's Helm new 26.9 starter (50.06% WR per the external aggregator) is canonical. Build pure tank - R conversion does the damage. Mercs viable (30.24% PR, 50.23% WR) into heavy CC.

Ornn.vs_tanks: Sunfire + Thornmail already core; Riftmaker swap for AP-tank flex
Ornn.vs_healing: Thornmail in core (built-in Grievous Wounds on hit)
Ornn.vs_burst: Kaenic Rookern earlier (move to 4th); Protoplasm Harness flex
Ornn.kit_notes: Forge-master tank; passive upgrades teammate items at L13. W brittle-passive enables stronger CC. R brittle-knockup AOE + remote knockup.
Ornn.build_note: Pure tank stack - Sunfire/Thornmail/Jak'Sho is the canonical 3-core. Ornn upgrades 1 item per ally at L13 (Sunfire->Bonfire Cataclysm, Thornmail->Leviathan, etc).

Renekton.vs_tanks: Black Cleaver already core (armor shred); Spear of Shojin alt 2nd (58.74% WR)
Renekton.vs_healing: Death's Dance for sustain or Chempunk swap for explicit Grievous Wounds
Renekton.kit_notes: Fury-stack lane bully; W stun (3-stack empowered = AOE root). E dash forward + return. R AOE + bonus HP/damage.
Renekton.build_note: Eclipse procs off W AOE empowered for big shield + true damage. Black Cleaver armor shred stacks fast through W spam. Spear of Shojin alt builds (59.72% WR with Sterak's) gain CDR pattern.

variants.name: shojin_haste
variants.note: 59.72% WR alt per the external aggregator

Camille.vs_tanks: Sterak's Gage / Spear of Shojin (58.67% WR core swap per the external aggregator)
Camille.vs_healing: Chempunk Chainsword swap for Ravenous Hydra
Camille.vs_burst: Guardian Angel / Maw of Malmortius earlier
Camille.kit_notes: Hextech-bruiser; passive shield on AA cycle scales with enemy MR/armor. E wall-jump-stun (charge & release). R AOE prison isolates targets - pick + 1v1.
Camille.build_note: Trinity Force Spellblade + Ravenous Hydra AOE define waveclear + skirmish. R isolates priority target - itemize bruiser stats to brawl post-engage. Mercury's Treads alt (33.47% PR) into CC.

Mordekaiser.first_back: Blasting Wand + Crystalline Bracer (toward Riftmaker / Rylai's)
Mordekaiser.vs_tanks: Liandry's already in core (% HP burn); Experimental Hexplate 4th (59.25% WR per the external aggregator)
Mordekaiser.vs_healing: Thornmail (56.12% WR as 4th per the external aggregator)
Mordekaiser.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass 4th (59.89% WR per the external aggregator)
Mordekaiser.kit_notes: Death-realm bruiser-mage; passive AOE empowered AA. E pull from medium range. R isolates target for 7s in death realm - 1v1 carry zone with stat steal.
Mordekaiser.build_note: Rylai's slow + Liandry's burn defines kiting + sustained DPS. Riftmaker omnivamp keeps him alive in melee. Plated Steelcaps prio over Mercs vs AD top lanes.

Warwick.vs_tanks: BotRK + Stridebreaker already core; Black Cleaver swap if 3+ tanks
Warwick.vs_healing: Thornmail in core (Grievous Wounds on hit)
Warwick.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage 4th (60.73% WR per the external aggregator); Spirit Visage vs heavy AP
Warwick.kit_notes: Sustain bruiser-jungler; passive + Q lifesteal scaling. W passive low-HP ping (track wounded enemies). R suppression - flash R is the engage tool.
Warwick.build_note: Stridebreaker + BotRK = % HP shred + sustain + MS. Mercs treads alt (40.64% PR, 53.25% WR) into heavy CC. Buffed in 26.9.

Kha'Zix.vs_tanks: Serylda's Grudge 4th (59.35% WR per the external aggregator)
Kha'Zix.vs_healing: Serpent's Fang 4th (55.94% WR per the external aggregator)
Kha'Zix.vs_burst: Edge of Night already in core (60.92% WR slot per the external aggregator) - keep at 4th or earlier
Kha'Zix.kit_notes: Evolution assassin; passive isolation bonus. W slow + heal on isolated targets. E dash. R 3-charge invis (evolve at 16 = unstoppable picks). Q evo true damage isolated.
Kha'Zix.build_note: Umbral Glaive ward-clear pen for vision-denied picks. Bastionbreaker shield-pierce defines burst pattern. Q evo first usually.

Hecarim.vs_tanks: Black Cleaver already core; Serylda's Grudge 5th
Hecarim.vs_healing: Chempunk Chainsword swap for Death's Dance vs sustain
Hecarim.vs_burst: Maw of Malmortius vs heavy AP; Sterak's earlier
Hecarim.kit_notes: MS-scaling cavalry; passive AD = bonus MS scaling. E ramp-charge knockback. R global ghost rush + fear engage.
Hecarim.build_note: Voltaic Cyclosword (26.9 ability-trigger) is a strong alt 1st but the external aggregator shows Spear of Shojin/Black Cleaver/DD as the 14.98% PR 55.38% WR core. Endless Hunger 5th (69.11% WR per the external aggregator).

Lillia.first_back: Blasting Wand + Lost Chapter components (toward Liandry's)
Lillia.vs_tanks: Rabadon's Deathcap 4th (62.69% WR per the external aggregator) for raw AP scaling vs Liandry burn
Lillia.vs_healing: Bloodletter's Curse 4th (61.22% WR per the external aggregator)
Lillia.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass 4th (66.55% WR per the external aggregator)
